name: file-info
description: Report file or directory metadata: size, mtime, permissions, type, mime guess, line count, or directory entry count. Check before reading unknown files.
use_when: checking a file's size/type before reading it

args.name: paths
args.description: One or more files/directories to inspect.

stdout: JSON object (single path) or array of objects with size, mtime, mode, mime, lines/entries.

exit_codes.1: one or more paths not found
